scope: Exact new v2 function signatures only; no historical migration, credential authority, owner, membership, schema, role or SECURITY DEFINER change.

exposure.statement: This is a 29-function proposed callable surface, not a nine-function exposed surface. Twenty helpers need nested invoker EXECUTE in the unchanged graph and remain directly callable where public is Data API exposed.
exposure.acceptance: Explicit acceptance of the twenty callable helpers is pending; otherwise a separately authorized no-new-authority refactor is required.
exposure.gates: Combined, real-runtime and production gates HOLD. No live owner, role membership, default privilege, exposed-schema or effective-grant capture is claimed.

ownership_expectations.new_function: Owned by installer current_user on first CREATE FUNCTION; CREATE OR REPLACE preserves an existing owner. No hardcoded live owner is assumed or changed.
ownership_expectations.administrative_caveat: Function owners can regrant privileges and superusers bypass ordinary ACL checks. The proposal does not create a privilege boundary against owner/superuser administrative authority.

callable_service_execute.unexpected_non_superuser_effective_execu: Reject installation unless the role is the per-function owner or service_role; includes inherited privilege from either allowed grantee.
callable_service_execute.default_privilege_handling: Revoke PUBLIC/anon/authenticated on exact signatures, grant service_role without adding a grant option, then fail closed on any remaining unexpected direct/default EXECUTE grantee, nonowner raw EXECUTE grant option or nonowner service effective EXECUTE WITH GRANT OPTION. Existing grant options are not silently repaired; no custom role or membership repairs.
callable_service_execute.schema_and_table_permissions: Function EXECUTE is separate from schema USAGE and invoker table privileges; no expansion of either is proposed.

trigger_no_service_execute.unexpected_non_superuser_effective_execu: Reject installation unless the role is the per-function owner; service_role is explicitly checked false even if it is an owner, superuser or inheritor.
trigger_no_service_execute.default_privilege_handling: Revoke PUBLIC/anon/authenticated and explicitly revoke service_role EXECUTE; fail closed if defaults, ownership or inheritance still provide forbidden effective access, a nonowner raw EXECUTE grant option or nonowner service effective EXECUTE WITH GRANT OPTION. No grant-option repair or owner/membership changes.
trigger_no_service_execute.runtime_semantics: Trigger creation checks installer function EXECUTE. Already-installed trigger firing does not require the DML caller to have function EXECUTE; trigger routines are not ordinary callable RPCs.

preserved_existing_authority.owner_acl_security: Existing owner, ACL and SECURITY DEFINER mode must remain exactly unchanged; not included in the new-function grant or preflight lists.

required: all 31 exact signatures match manifest; all new functions SECURITY INVOKER
all 29 callable signatures service execute true and anon/authenticated false
both triggers service execute false; normal APIs and guard enforcement still work
each of twenty helper revocations independently breaks an intended API with 42501 in synthetic fixture
default/custom and inherited privilege variants fail closed without modifying owners or memberships
preexisting/default/inherited nonowner EXECUTE WITH GRANT OPTION fails closed without repairing delegation authority
validation_requirements.execution_status: Not executed by the manifest author. Synthetic in-process evidence must identify the exact correction bytes; no real-runtime or production conclusion is implied.
